scripts.build: bun run schema && bun build src/main.ts --target=node --format=esm --outdir=. --entry-naming=orchestrate.mjs --sourcemap=external --minify && chmod 755 orchestrate.mjs
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run test:unit && bun run test:contract:built
scripts.test:contract: bun run build && bun run test:contract:built
scripts.test:unit: bun test test/orchestrate.test.ts test/providers.test.ts test/cli.test.ts test/preferences.test.ts test/effect-runtime.test.ts test/wake-runtime.test.ts test/mirror.test.ts test/interactive.test.ts
scripts.verify: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run check && bun run test
